body:
Found while scoping WOTAN_HAT_STORE_NORTHSTAR.md Phase 2: handleBuyHat/handleEquipHat in hats.go had no ownership check at all -- any authenticated player JWT could buy/equip hats against any character_id, spending another player's own Flow. Fixed with the same agent-exempt/sub==player_id pattern handleUpdatePosition already uses. 5 new tests added, go build/vet/test ./... clean. Commit 9537796.

⚓ ☃
title: Security fix: hat buy/equip endpoints had no ownership check
